visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of raw pork belly cubes and ginger slices sizzling in a heavy black pot on a sleek Panasonic induction stovetop. Steam wafts up as the meat begins to brown in the center of the frame. (2) A white cordless vacuum cleaner head moves rhythmically across a polished light-colored wood floor in a brightly lit room. A person's foot in a pink slipper is briefly seen, indicating cleaning activity while food cooks. (3) The camera focuses on a young woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a white shirt and a grey denim-style apron. She has a focused expression, looking down at the pot as she manages the cooking. (4) A hand pours dark soy sauce and then sprinkles white sugar or salt into the pot of meat. Yellow text labels the ingredients like soy sauce as they are added to the mixture. (5) The person adds rice wine from a white bottle and uses a light wood spatula to stir the meat pieces, ensuring they are evenly coated in the darkening sauce. (6) Hot water is poured from a white pitcher into the simmering pot, followed by a small white cloth spice bag. The contents are stirred once more before a heavy white ceramic lid is placed on top. (7) A wide shot shows the woman mopping a long, bright white hallway with a flat mop. The home environment is minimalist with light wood doors and very clean white walls. (8) The camera pans across the tidy kitchen, showing the white induction stove and wood cabinets. A hand lifts the lid of the pot, revealing the finished, glistening brown braised pork bubbling gently. (9) The final shot shows a white plastic container being opened to reveal a previously prepared batch of braised beef brisket with carrots, highlighting the meal prep routine.

(6) [Subtitle]: 蠔油. (7) [Subtitle]: 米酒. (8) [Subtitle]: 翻炒一下讓豬油跟調味料融合. (9) [Subtitle]: 注意一下順序就會很好吃喔. (10) [Subtitle]: 接著加入熱開水跟滷包. (11) [Subtitle]: 蓋蓋悶煮半小時 用小火就好了. (12) [Subtitle]: 接著把握時間拖地. (13) [Subtitle]: 喜歡家裡乾乾淨淨的. (14) [Subtitle]: 乾淨的地板跟廚房 讓我心情好. (15) [Subtitle]: 偷看一下肉肉們. (16) [Subtitle]: 完成啦！簡單好吃的台式滷肉. (17) [Subtitle]: 旁邊是昨天滷的紅燒牛腩 一天的時間就沒了.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with the aggressive, high-frequency sizzle of fat rendering and meat searing in a pan. A light, upbeat acoustic guitar and piano melody plays in the background, providing a cheerful and domestic mood. The tempo is steady and moderate. (2) The sizzling abruptly cuts away, replaced by the mid-range mechanical whir of a vacuum cleaner motor. The background music continues at the same volume, creating a sense of continuous productive activity despite the change in physical task. (3) The loud sizzling returns with prominent percussive scraping sounds of a spatula against the metal pan surface. Sharp 'ding' sound effects punctuate the audio track, coinciding with the appearance of recipe text on the screen. (4) The sounds of liquid being poured (soy sauce and wine) add a splashy, wet texture to the constant sizzle. The BGM remains the dominant tonal layer, maintaining a positive emotional valence throughout the culinary preparation sequence. (5) The sizzling transitions into a softer, bubbling liquid sound as water is added. A metallic clink signals the lid being placed on the pot. The background music's melody becomes more prominent as the environmental noises soften. (6) Sounds of a mop sliding across a hard floor—a rhythmic, swishing noise—dominate this phase. The acoustic music continues, blending with the domestic sounds to create a relaxing and industrious atmosphere without any human speech. (7) The lid of the pot is lifted with a slight suction-breaking sound, followed by the rich, low-frequency bubbling of the finished stew. The upbeat BGM reaches its conclusion, ending on a bright, resolved musical note.
